notes.title: Menu update!
notes.notes:
Our dedicated team has been hard at work on the development of our game, and we're excited to share some important news with you. In our latest update, we've introduced several improvements, including a fresh new UI for our demo.

But that's not all. We've also taken the time to fix various bugs that have been affecting your gameplay, such as the issues with faulty checkpoints and grab bars.

This update represents the final enhancement for our demo version. Moving forward, we'll be focusing our efforts on the development of the full game. We appreciate your support and enthusiasm as we've worked on refining the gaming experience.

We hope you find the changes and bug fixes beneficial as you explore the game. Your feedback has been instrumental in making these improvements, and we look forward to your continued enjoyment of our work.

Thank you for being a part of our journey!

notes.title: Singleplay and more!!
notes.notes:
We have an important announcement to make regarding our game demo. In the near future, the demo will be temporarily unavailable as we work on a big update that brings some amazing changes.

The highlight of this update is the introduction of a singleplayer mode! We've been listening to your feedback and are thrilled to bring you a new way to enjoy the game. Alongside this, we have some surprises in store that will enhance your gaming experience.

We understand this might be disappointing news, but we're confident that the new features will be worth the wait. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share these exciting changes with you.

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your understanding.
